selection_rule: Retain Pelosi and Greene. Expanded-v1 selected new names alphabetically by digital filing availability; after that run showed no eligible stock purchases for Beyer, Collins and DelBene, retain Allen and examine the next three names (Doggett, Foxx, Franklin). This coverage-based refinement was made before calculating those three members returns. Allocation rules are unchanged. The earlier v1 run remains available; this is exploratory research, not preregistration.
portfolio_groups: Each individual plus an equal-initial-capital six-person portfolio; no cash transfers across sleeves.
data_policy: Any parsing error blocks affected politician and combined runs; missing held-position price blocks a run, missing entry quotes flagged; no retroactive ticker guesses. All blocked combinations remain in results. Rules will not be tuned after reviewing returns.
interpretation: Exploratory retrospective comparison, not preregistered research or an untouched holdout. Standalone-year runs begin in cash. Neither politician selection nor rule selection establishes future profitability.

coverage_exclusions.DelBene: Only two eligible stock sales, no eligible stock purchases
